doc.title: Scott Hamilton interviewed by Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995

title: Listening to 1950s R&B tenor players
summary: As a teenager he listened to Red Prysock, Clifford Scott, Phil Austin and Rusty Bryant, whose records are now being reissued.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Who were you listening to at that time?

I was playing a lot of — I was listening to a lot of rhythm and blues tenor players from the 50s at the time — Red Prysock, Clifford Scott, Phil Austin, people like that. Rusty Bryant. Kind of unusual names to hear these days, I don’t hear very much about these
guys very often. But I’ve noticed that some of their records are being reissued now, so maybe they’re due for a Renaissance or something.
